one_sentence_story: After surgeons cut the 200-million-wire bridge between a patient's two brain halves to stop seizures, his silent right brain pointed his left hand at a snow shovel while his speaking left brain — blind to the snow picture — smoothly made up an excuse about cleaning a chicken coop.
so_what_for_you: Your left brain runs a storytelling 'interpreter' every single day: whenever your habits or emotions make you act for reasons you did not consciously notice, your inner narrator invents a confident explanation on the spot.
